physicalEvidence.summary: The June 2026 Tactile Genesis paper trains a privileged PPO teacher and a tactile DAgger student, then transfers palm rotation to a real XHand1. The test controls thumb and middle finger, with the remaining fingers fixed. Appendix C reports only 1–2 consecutive rotations before dropping the object. First author Chung is independently verified as Nayebi’s MSR advisee; this is a limited current physical proof of concept, not validation of all three simulated tasks or all sensing modalities.
